meta.name: standup
meta.description: Facilitate a read-only standup across git worktrees, branches, or PRs to compare changes and produce one consolidation plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 汇总多个分支或PR的变更，生成统一计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在多个工作分支间快速同步变更并制定合并计划
copy.tagline_en: Aggregate changes across branches or PRs into one consolidation plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly sync changes across multiple work branches and create a merge plan

howto.what: Claude 当主持人,把每个 git worktree(和你选的 PR)当作一个 agent 拉进共享 markdown 聊天室,分轮让它们对照改动、解决冲突,最后亲自写出合并方案:哪个作目标、按什么顺序合并。只读,不提交不合并。
howto.when: 当你有多个 worktree、分支或 PR 需要对照、想汇总成一份合并方案时;可按 1h、24h、7d 等活动窗口筛,也可手动点名分支/PR。候选不足两个时它会说明这不是 standup。

say.text: 把最近 24 小时有改动的 worktree 拉进来开 standup
say.note: 按窗口筛出活跃的 worktree

say.text: 只对比这两个分支和一个 PR,看该怎么合并
把最终的合并方案用大白话讲给我听
say.note: 给出目标 worktree 与合并顺序

howto.what_en: Claude facilitates: each git worktree (and picked PRs) joins a shared markdown room as an agent. Rounds compare changes and settle conflicts; Claude then writes the plan — target worktree and merge order. Read-only; nothing merges.
howto.when_en: Use it when several worktrees, branches or PRs need comparing into one plan. The roster comes from a time window (1h, 24h, 7d) or named branches/PRs; fewer than two candidates isn't a standup.

say_en.text: Pull the worktrees changed in the last 24 hours into a standup
Compare just these two branches and one PR — how should they merge?
say_en.note: Shows the roster for you to confirm

say_en.text: Explain the final merge plan in plain language
say_en.note: Gives target worktree and merge order
